routes.name: Algeria entry visa (tourist, business, family)
routes.summary: Most foreigners need a visa from an Algerian embassy or consulate before travel. Validity can be 90 days, 180 days, 1 year or 2 years, with up to 90 days per stay and 180 days per year.

other: Some nationals are exempt from the visa, but the official page doesn't list them. Ask the embassy.
Tourists need a legalized host certificate, a hotel booking, or a travel agency certificate showing the trip
Business visas need a mission letter from your employer or an invitation from an Algerian partner, plus a hotel booking or inviting organization's certificate
Family visas need an accommodation certificate from an Algerian family member, legalized by the town hall
Passport valid 6+ months, travel insurance and repatriation assistance certificate
Apply at the embassy or consulate for your usual place of residence

stay.note: Max 90 days per entry, extendable exceptionally by up to 90 more. Total stay no more than 180 days per year. Extension possible in Algeria under certain conditions.

documents: Travel insurance and repatriation assistance certificate
Hotel booking, agency certificate or legalized host certificate, depending on visa type

fees.label: Tourism, business, family, student, medical, press (US applicants)

routes.processing: Organized tours through tourist agencies: visa issued within 48 hours of a complete file. Otherwise about 5 to 8 business days on average at the Washington embassy.

routes.name: Algeria work and temporary work visa
routes.summary: For foreigners with a job in Algeria. You need a Temporary Work Authorization, an employment contract and a repatriation commitment from the employer.

other: Temporary Work Authorization, employment contract and commitment to repatriate the worker when the job ends

sources.label: Algeria Ministry of Foreign Affairs: entry visa to Algeria
Embassy of Algeria in Washington: entry visa to Algeria

routes.name: Algeria student visa
routes.summary: For students. Show a registration certificate from a public or private school approved by Algeria, or a scholarship certificate, or proof you can pay for your studies and stay.

other: Registration certificate from an Algerian-approved public or private school, OR a scholarship certificate from Algerian or home-country authorities, OR proof of means to pay for studies and stay

sources.label: Algeria Ministry of Foreign Affairs: entry visa to Algeria
Embassy of Algeria in Washington: entry visa to Algeria

routes.name: Algeria temporary work visa (up to 3 months)
routes.summary: For short assignments of up to 3 months. A service or assistance contract needs no prior temporary work authorization. An employment contract needs the Provisional Authorization for Temporary Work (APTT) and a repatriation commitment.

other: Service or assistance contract (no APTT needed), or employment contract plus APTT and repatriation commitment

sources.label: Algeria Ministry of Foreign Affairs: entry visa to Algeria

routes.name: Algeria cultural visa
routes.summary: For seminars or cultural, scientific or sporting events. Needs an invitation to the event and proof of resources for your stay.

other: Invitation to a seminar or cultural, scientific or sporting event
Proof of resources for the stay

sources.label: Algeria Ministry of Foreign Affairs: entry visa to Algeria

routes.name: Algeria transit visa
routes.summary: Needs the entry visa for your destination if it requires one, plus proof of resources. Transit stay is 7 days at most. Ship and aircraft crews get stopover permits of 2 to 7 days.

other: Visa for the destination country if required
